sql:
SELECT
  t2.skill,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t1.posting_key) AS listings_mentioning
FROM fct_posting AS t1
INNER JOIN posting_skills AS t2
  ON t1.posting_key = t2.posting_key
WHERE
  t1.is_open = TRUE AND t1.remote_us = TRUE AND t1.is_canonical_listing = TRUE
GROUP BY
  t2.skill
ORDER BY
  listings_mentioning DESC
LIMIT 10;
